state.intended_appearance: Dimensional blue sealing wax with a clearcoat sheen and a rounded poured perimeter; raised satin gold-leaf C/check and ring lettering with broad highlights rather than mirror reflections; woven green ribbons. Visible highlights and depth are intentional.

criteria.true: Gloss, reflection strength, highlight contrast and edge roundness suit the stated finish, whether restrained or glossy.
criteria.false: The visible finish contradicts the stated direction, even if it is competently executed in another style.
